image_description: A large, ornate pipe organ situated on a raised wooden gallery within a stone cathedral or church interior. The organ features a symmetrical arrangement of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, with the tallest pipes in the center and shorter ones flanking them. The instrument is housed in a decorative wooden case with carved details. Below the pipes is the console area, though specific keyboards are not clearly visible from this distance. The gallery is supported by wooden beams and arches, set against a backdrop of Gothic-style stone architecture with vaulted ceilings.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific classification of the instrument as a pipe organ and distinguish it from other architectural elements.
To verify the structural integrity of the pipes and ensure they are properly grounded in the gallery without floating or melting artifacts.
To check for edge bleeding between the complex pipe structures and the background architecture, ensuring clean boundaries.
To assess general image quality, looking for subtle texture anomalies or blurring in the intricate details of the organ.

Connection points of pipes to the windchest/gallery

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the base of the pipes where they meet the wooden structure; AI often fails to render the mechanical connection points realistically. Check for any 'melting' of the smaller pipes into the background shadows.
